pages.title: Femtoscale Capacitor
pages.text: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton. Two plates femtometres apart store charge, helped by the vacuum pressure pressing them together from outside. It is far too small to see, and I keep it in a sealed vial so that I do not inhale it by accident.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator I trimmed a Casimir Plate with Neutronium Plate and Superconducting Solder until the spacing was smaller than a proton. The capacitance went up, as Casimir predicted.
